What this view shows

Stock removal and tool positions come from the simulated movements. Voxel stock is an approximation. Workpiece playback uses a schematic mill. Haas VF-2 and Setup show the actual exported machine, prepared vise, soft jaw and library tool envelopes in a parked reference pose. Those reference assets are not included in the pocket-demo collision verdict. Cycle times assume constant commanded speeds.
